sections.title: In brief
sections.text: This chapter, subtitled “Problems of Predictability,” studies how restrictions on rules affect grammar behavior.

sections.title: Question or aim
sections.text: How much can a designer predict before using a grammar to generate designs?

sections.title: Approach described
sections.text: Grammars are classified by rule restrictions and their possible behaviors and outcomes are examined.

sections.title: What the abstract supports
sections.text: The abstract argues that understanding predictability is central to designing useful grammars for creative applications.

sections.title: What remains unverified
sections.text: Only the publisher abstract was read. Specific classes, proofs and examples are not reproduced here, and no empirical success rate is reported in the abstract.

sections.title: Why it may help
sections.text: It shifts the design task from choosing a pleasing output toward understanding and shaping the system that produces outputs.
